hook: Your gym session in space means being strapped to a treadmill.
title: Astronauts Get Strapped Into Their Gym
description:
Astronauts on the ISS exercise about two hours a day. They run on a treadmill held down by a harness and lift using vacuum piston machines. Without it, their bones and muscles waste away.

#Shorts #space #ISS
comment_prompt: Would you enjoy this workout? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your gym session in space is strapped on.
scenes.headline: STRAPPED TO A TREADMILL

scenes.narration: Astronauts run in a harness on a treadmill.
scenes.headline: RUNNING IN A HARNESS

scenes.narration: Without it, they would just float away.
scenes.headline: NOTHING HOLDS YOU

scenes.narration: They also lift using vacuum piston machines.
scenes.headline: VACUUM LIFTING

scenes.narration: Weights float, so the machine pushes back.
scenes.headline: THE MACHINE PUSHES

scenes.narration: About two hours of this, almost every day.
scenes.headline: ABOUT 2 HOURS

scenes.narration: Skip it, and bones and muscles waste away.
scenes.headline: BONES WASTE AWAY

scenes.narration: Your workout, strapped down, hundreds of kilometres up.
scenes.headline: GYM IN ORBIT

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: a phone test with your ceiling fan.
scenes.headline: TOMORROW
